top_signals.title: BOJ is said to lean against back-to-back rate hike in October
top_signals.summary: The BOJ officials see little need for consecutive rate hikes in the absence of signs that upside inflation risks will increase abruptly.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Japan to Compensate Oil Importers for High Shipping Costs
top_signals.summary: The Japanese government on Tuesday approved three bills to boost diversification of oil supplies and energy security, including grants to compensate Japan’s oil importers for the high shipping costs to procure supply from alternative sources.      The bills will now be introduced for debate at the Japanese Parliament.  The legislation is aimed at improving “supply security by diversifying sources of crude oil and other fossil fuels and reducing related risks,” Japan’s Industry ‌Minister…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Lidl snaps up market share as rival Aldi stalls
top_signals.summary: Lidl is the fastest-growing grocer in the UK, new figures suggest, as the discount supermarket grabs more market share while its rivals stall. The German discounter held 8.6 per cent of the UK’s grocer market in the 12 weeks to October, according to Worldpanel by Numerator, up from 8.2 per cent a year ago.  This [...]
